args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List for Your Vacation

### Clothing & Accessories
- Lightweight swimwear and cover-ups
- Sun hats and sunglasses
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts for beach days
- Quick-dry swim trunks or board shorts
- Comfortable walking shoes and sandals
- Light jackets for cool evenings or mountain areas
- Beach towels and sarongs

### Toiletries & Essentials
- Sunscreen with high SPF (reapply often!)
- Lip balm with SPF
- Insect repellent
- Travel-sized shampoo, conditioner, and body wash
- Toothbrush, toothpaste, and dental floss
- Travel-sized laundry detergent or biodegradable soap
- Towels and beach umbrellas
- Beach towels and sarongs
- Reusable water bottle

### Electronics & Devices
- Travel adapter for US outlets
- Portable phone charger
- Waterproof phone case
- Travel-sized electronics charger
- Camera or GoPro for beach shots
- Extra batteries or portable power bank

### Travel Documents
- Passport and travel insurance documents
- Travel itinerary and hotel confirmation
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel insurance policy details
- Emergency contact information

### Miscellaneous
- Travel-sized first aid kit
- Snorkel and mask if planning water activities
- Beach chairs and umbrellas
- Travel-sized medications
- Travel-sized electronics charger
- Snorkel and mask if planning water activities
- Beach chairs and umbrellas
